📝 Mayor's Blog Update (Published: November 3, 2026)

On Tuesday, November 3, 2026 (a national holiday), Hanno City Hall hosted the Reiwa 8 Hanno City Honors Ceremony.

Twenty-seven honorees who have contributed to the city's development and growth attended the ceremony, where they received certificates of commendation and letters of appreciation.
